title: ASHA calls spelling pseudoscience

tellings.quote: spelling is not a valid form of communication they've called it pseudo science

plain: Ky Dickens, a filmmaker behind a documentary about nonspeaking children who are said to read minds, says the American Speech-Language-Hearing Association, a US professional body for speech therapists, rejects "spelling". That is a method where nonspeaking people point to letters to communicate. She says the association calls it not a valid form of communication and labels it pseudoscience, which matters because her children's stories come through that method.
